newsitem.title: UK: UK manufacturing pay awards remain stable - CBI.
newsitem.headline: UK manufacturing pay awards remain stable - CBI.

text.p: Pay awards in Britain's manufacturing sector were steady in the three months to June, averaging 3.3 percent, employers lobby the Confederation of British Industry said on Monday.
That represented a slight increase on the 3.2 percent average over the three months to the end of March, but down from the 3.5 percent in the same period last year.
Service sector pay awards were only slightly higher even though service firms were enjoying much more buoyant conditions.
Pay awards there averaged 3.6 percent in the three months to the end of June, level with the previous quarter and the same period last year.

The CBI noted 38 percent of manufacturers said their inability to raise prices was keeping the lid on wage rises. A quarter identified low profits as a key factor while 19 percent said low inflation was important.
